create_model_jax_compatible: create a JAX-compatible frozen Pydantic model with static and dynamic fields for JIT compilation
build_tree_flatten_model: build a JAX pytree flatten representation separating static and dynamic fields from a BaseModelFrozen instance
build_tree_unflatten_model: build a BaseModelFrozen instance from JAX pytree dynamic children and static auxiliary data
build_nested_model_tree: build a treelib.Tree representation of a nested BaseModelFrozen model hierarchy
update_nested_model_fields: update nested BaseModelFrozen fields by dotted path with validation and cached property invalidation
